definitions.explanation: The joint in the middle of the leg.
The upper part of the legs when sitting, where someone might sit or place things.

notes:
{膝|ひざ} covers both "knee" (the joint) and "lap" (the upper leg surface when sitting). Context makes the meaning clear.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {膝|ひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧: to bend the knee
- {膝|ひざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to kneel
- {膝|ひざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have bad knees
- {膝|ひざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せる→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧: to place on one's lap

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{膝|ひざ}{枕|まくら}→膝枕：14075_hizamakura⟧ (hizamakura) — resting one's head on another person's lap — is a tender, intimate gesture often depicted in anime and manga. Knee problems are a very common topic of conversation among older Japanese people.

- ⟦{膝|ひざ}{小僧|こぞう}→膝小僧：noentry⟧: kneecap (colloquial)
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}{掛|か}け→膝掛け：18166_hizakake⟧: lap blanket
